source._build_note: SINGLE Go module (go.mod at root = github.com/seaweedfs/seaweedfs) whose `weed` main package lives in the weed/ SUBDIR -> main_pkg is the package path ./weed built from the module root (go build ./weed). NO codegen for the offline build: the protobuf .pb.go AND the templ-generated *_templ.go (Admin UI) are COMMITTED in-tree (.gitignore ignores neither), so protoc/templ are NOT needed. DO NOT run the Makefile admin-generate/install-templ targets — they fetch github.com/a-h/templ over the network (breaks --network=none); build the weed package directly. a-h/templ is a normal go.mod require (the committed _templ.go imports it at runtime) and vendors cleanly. CGO off -> fully static binary.
